headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals have transferred right-handed pitcher Nick Mears to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. The Boston Red Sox have bolstered their outfield by acquiring outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade, which included a Player To Be Named Later. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed right-handed pitcher Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their team's availability. The Kansas City Royals' Nick Mears has been transferred to the 60-day injured list, while the Baltimore Orioles' Keegan Akin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. The Arizona Diamondbacks' Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list, and the Texas Rangers' Chris Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder impingement.

The Boston Red Sox have acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade with the Detroit Tigers for a Player To Be Named Later. The Kansas City Royals have acquired right-handed pitcher Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles have acquired right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox have traded left-handed pitcher Brandon Eisert and first baseman Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for left-handed pitcher Jaden Woods and Future Considerations.
